result.paraphrase: Mpn: ST6000DM003 Vendor: Seagate BarraCuda HDD 3.5" 6TB SATA 5400RPM 256MB CACHE 2YRS Versatile HDDs for all your PC needs deliver industry-leading excellence in personal computing. For more than 20 years, the BarraCuda line has provided highly reliable storage to the hard drive industry. With capacities up to 8TB for desktops, BarraCuda offers the broadest range of storage choices available. Advanced power modes help conserve energy without reducing performance. The SATA 6Gb/s interface improves burst performance. Seagate Secure models offer hardware-based Self-Encrypting Drive (SED) data protection and include an Instant Secure Erase feature for safe, quick, and simple drive retirement. They comply with NIST 800-88 media sanitization requirements and also support the Trusted Computer Group (TCG) Opal standard.
